items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 52:1
items.html: For the whole expansion of the Nekudim came from the sockets of the eyes, meaning the screen of Behina Alef. It follows that after the shattering of the vessels was completed, the screen was refined entirely of its coarseness and became equal to the aspect of the screen of the Rosh, and it is thus considered to have risen there, to the Rosh, and to be included in the screen of the Rosh, for equivalence of form makes them one, as is known. You already know that all the records of the expansion of the Nekudim are included from the screen. Hence it follows that the screen that was refined carried with it the whole expansion of the Nekudim up to the GAR, meaning to the Rosh of Nekudim. (Inner Light, page 599, Sub Header, “Returned”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 53:1
items.html: Because the GAR of the Nekudim, too, was not complete, for after the illumination of the coupling of AB-SAG of AK in the Nekudim ceased, the lower Hei and the restriction returned to the place of the sockets of the eyes, at which point they were not fit for coupling. Hence GAR, too, was compelled to rise up to the one above them, which is the head of SAG of AK. (Inner Light, page 601, Sub Header, “The Raising,” and Inner Observation, item 3)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 54:1
items.html: In truth, only the Nekudot of SAG are considered to be above the Nekudim, and not the Taamim of SAG, as explained in Inner Observation, Part 6. However, through the raising of MAN, the Nekudot of SAG are found joining with the Taamim of SAG into one, and the Nekudot do not rise by name. (Inner Light, page 601, Sub Header, “The Mochin”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 55:1
items.html: For the entire matter of the raising of MAN is the arousal of the connection that Bina of AVI has with ZON of AVI, to impart to them the illumination of Hochma, as written (Part 7, answer 35). And from this comes the rule that MAN rises only from the aspects of ZON in every Sefira, and the place of the rising is the Bina in every Sefira. (Inner Light, page 604, Sub Header, “And They Need”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 56:1
items.html: The filling of HaVaYaH with Yodin indicates that the second restriction is not revealed in them, but they are only of the aspect of the first restriction. And the filling of HaVaYaH with Alfin indicates that the coupling comes from the second restriction (as explained at length above, Part 6, Answer 1). This is hinted at in the shape of the letter Aleph, for its shape is two Yods with a Parsa between them: the upper Yod is the secret of Keter and Hochma that remained in the degree, and is the secret of the Upper Waters; and the lower Yod is the secret of AHP that went outside; and the line separating between them is the secret of the Parsa, through which, by the upper coupling of AB and SAG, a new light comes out and breaks through this Parsa, and returns AHP to the degree. (Inner Light, Item 603, Sub Header, “MA”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 57:1
items.html: See Part 6, answer 1 — this is explained there at length. (ibid., Sub Header, “And although”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 58:1
items.html: See above, answer 52, that the entire expansion of the Nekudim comes from the coarseness of phase one, and it is known that the last phase of coarseness is lost at the time of purification. Hence, nothing remained in the screen but the residue from the coarseness of Keter, and so the coupling took place in the place of the forehead, which is the aspect of Keter. (Inner Light, page 599, Sub Header, “Decree”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 59:1
items.html: The Galgalta divides into GAR and ZAT, corresponding to Bina and corresponding to Tifferet: from the forehead upward, which is covered with hair, is considered GAR, and there is no revelation of the illumination of Hochma there; and from the forehead downward is the phase of the ZAT of Bina, which is the place for the revelation of the illumination of Hochma. (Inner Light, page 604, s.v. "and they need")

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 60:1
items.html: Because there is no longer any actual coarseness in the screen, but only the aspect of the root of coarseness, it therefore does not even have a subtle aspect of looking, but only the revelation of illumination alone. (Inner Light, p. 604, entry "The words")

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 61:1
items.html: Phase Four, Phase Three, and Phase Two — which are the three levels of Galgalta, AB, and SAG — came out in AK. Phase One, which is the level of ZA, came out in Nekudim. And the phase of the coarseness of Keter came out in Atzilut, which is the level of Malchut, called BON. However, since there is there the aspect of the record of Phase One of clothing, which is the level of ZA, Atzilut, too, is therefore also called by the name MA. (Inner Observation, item 2) (Note by our master the author: but in order to distinguish it from the MA of AK, which is the Nekudim, it is called the new MA.)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 62:1
items.html: Because the new light that broke through the curtain, which the Nekudim received from AV and SAG of AK, caused them a complete expansion, just as in AK itself. (ibid.)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 63:1
items.html: This is according to the distance of the second restriction from the first restriction, which is the place of the Bina and ZON of the NHY of AK. For the legs of AK end at the point of this world, while the legs of Atzilut end a little higher, in the Bina of the NHY of AK. (Inner Light, page 607, s.v. "a little")

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 64:1
items.html: It is by force of the lower Hei that rose to the forehead, meaning to Keter, where the root of the Partzuf is. There it received great force and strength, so that even at the time of the coupling of Gadlut, when a new light descends and breaks through the Parsa, the Parsa nonetheless remains in its existence, and the boundary is not annulled — only an illumination expands and connects the AHP to the degree. (Inner Light, page 616, Sub Header, “And Behold You”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 65:1
items.html: See answer 64 below.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 66:1
items.html: In the Rosh of SAG of AK, that is where the joining of the quality of mercy with judgment began, but only through the inclusion of the coupling of the screen of the Guf within the Rosh, and even this was revealed only in the secret of the hairs of the beard. (Inner Light, p. 630, entry "And behold you")

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 67:1
items.html: Because of the absence of the light of Chochma in them. For due to the second restriction, the point of restriction rose from this world to the place of the Bina of the NHY of AK, where the Parsa that separates Atzilut from Beria was made, and there the line from Ein Sof ended, and the three worlds of BYA are found below the point of restriction, for the light of Chochma cannot pass from the point of restriction downward, as is known. Hence they are called the worlds of separation, for they were separated from the light of Chochma, which is the essence and vitality called Atzilut. (page 599, Sub Header, “To Give Life”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 68:1
items.html: For all the Partzufim of Atzilut came out upon the screen and the records of Nekudim, and since the reign of the ten Sefirot of Nekudim spread into BYA, the coarseness of BYA is mixed into those records. Hence, after their inclusion in the coupling of the head, in which the coarseness that was originally in them was renewed, the coarseness of BYA, too, was revealed in them. Therefore, at the time of their birth — meaning, after their coarseness was discerned and they came out from the head — they were compelled to fall and come to BYA, because the coarseness of BYA, too, was discerned in them. (Inner Light, page 637, Sub Header, “And It Is Fitting”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 69:1
items.html: And you need to know that Atik is an intermediary between AK and Atzilut, meaning that both restrictions apply to it. For on the part of the Malchut of AK clothed within it, it is considered like AK, meaning of the first restriction, which ends at the point of this world. However, on the part of its own screen, it is considered the second restriction, and it ends at the Parsa between Atzilut and Beria, like the rest of the Partzufim of Atzilut. You also know that those AHP of the ten Sefirot of NHY of AK, in whose measure is the place for BYA, are considered only NHY of NHY, since the Bina that goes outward is only from her ZAT downward, but in her GAR, which are the light of Hassadim, the matter of going out does not apply at all, since the light of Hassadim is never restricted and never coarsened, for the whole matter of restriction applies only to the light of Hochma. It follows that only ZON of Bina, and the true ZON, went out beyond Atzilut. And through the power of the illumination of the correction of the lines, the HGT of ZON were also raised to Atzilut, so that the KHB HGT of the ten Sefirot of these NHY remained within Atzilut, and only NHY alone went out from them to Beria. And when you divide them by the secret of the thirds, you find that of the two upper thirds of each line — namely Hochma-Hesed of the right line, Bina-Gevura of the left line, and Daat-Tifferet of the middle line — remained within Atzilut, and only the lower thirds went out to Beria, namely Netzah of the right line and Hod of the left line, meaning the lower third of the right and the lower third of the left. But the lower third of the middle line is not present here in NHY of AK, since the whole illumination of the middle line is Yesod, and in Yesod there are only two thirds, as is known, and it has no lower third. Hence Atik, too, on the part of the Malchut of AK clothed within it, is likewise drawn down to the point of this world, and hence the two lower thirds of its Netzah and Hod go out to BYA — just like AK. (Inner Light, page 641, Sub Header, “And It Is Found”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 70:1
items.html: Malchut is so called when she is without the sweetening of the attribute of mercy, for ‘human breasts’ indicate the sweetened abundance in the attribute of mercy, by which Malchut was corrected in the second restriction. And ‘animal breasts’ indicate that she lacks the connection of the attribute of mercy that sweetens her. Therefore, those lower two breasts of Netzach and Hod of Atik, which are found below the Parsa of Atzilut, and which nurse the Partzufim by force of the first restriction — where Malchut is not yet sweetened there in the attribute of mercy — are called ‘animal breasts.’ This is the secret of their standing in the place of nakedness, meaning that the external forces have a hold in them, since they lack the sweetening of the attribute of mercy. (Inner Light, Item 643, Sub Header, “And They Are Called”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 71:1
items.html: For two corrections are needed: the first is the separation of the coarseness of BYA that is in them, and the second is the aspect of existence while they are still in Beria. Since Atik includes within him the two forces of the first restriction and the second restriction, as above in the preceding Answer 69, by drawing from the Ben Shesh of his Netzach and Hod, they acquire these two corrections: by the force of the second restriction corrected in him, they acquire the power to separate the coarseness of BYA that is in them, and by the first restriction included in him, they receive from him the aspect of existence and vitality while they are still in BYA. (Ibid., Sub Header, “The Essence”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 72:1
items.html: For although they have only the level of a single Sefira, namely the level of Malchut alone, nevertheless, by virtue of the correction of the lines that they attained, they became three Sefirot in width — right, middle, and left — which are therefore called NHY. But their level was not enlarged. (Inner Light, page 608, s.v. "gestation")

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 73:1
items.html: For although the last phase, which is phase one, was lost, still an aspect of clothing remained from it, as is known. However, there are no vessels from it, since vessels expand only from the aspect of coarseness. Therefore, there is also there the stature of Zeir Anpin, which is MA, but since there are no vessels in it, it clothes in NHY, in the secret of three within three. (613, Sub Header, “And Already”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 74:1
items.html: The screen and the records included in it rose to the inclusion of the coupling in the Rosh of SAG, and after their coarseness was recognized, they descended to their place, namely to the Peh of the Rosh of Nekudim, and that same coupling that was in them in the inclusion of the upper one returned to them, and they brought forth the ten Sefirot of the Rosh from the Peh of Nekudim and upward to the Tabur of AK, and from the Peh of Nekudim downward to the end of Atzilut came out their Guf. (Inner Light, page 610, Sub Header, “Light”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 75:1
items.html: Because the new Mah emerged upon the screen of Nekudim after it was refined, as is known, and the entire root of Nekudim is from the navel of AK downward, for above the navel is the aspect of Akudim, as is known. (Inner Light, p. 606, entry "And the light")

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 76:1
items.html: Since GAR of Nekudim were likewise not complete, and they too were corrected by this coupling of the Rosh of Atik, which is the phase of their male, they therefore held it in their place. (Note from our master the author: This is not necessary at all, for Atik is the first head of Atzilut, like Yeshsut of Nekudim, and hence its place is from the end of Tifferet of Nekudim to the navel, equal to GAR of Nekudim.) (Inner Light, page 611, Sub Header, “And Indeed”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 77:1
items.html: Because the ten Sefirot of the Rosh of Atik came out there in their place, namely from the Peh of the Rosh of Nekudim and upward to the Tabur of AK, and this level illuminates all of GAR of Nekudim standing there, hence Atik is considered to have taken the GAR of Hochma and Bina. However, from the phase of Bina, it also took Hesed, because as long as there is no expansion of Bina into ZAT, the light of Hesed is found standing in GAR of Bina. (Inner Light, page 626, Sub Header, “And Also”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 78:1
items.html: Because it is the Malchut of AK that clothes in Atik of Atzilut, which comes from the first restriction, whereas all the Partzufim of Atzilut are from the second restriction, in which Malchut is sweetened in the quality of mercy, in the secret of Bina. Therefore, the Malchut of the first restriction has no revelation whatsoever in the world of Atzilut, and she is hidden in the head of Atik. (618, items 23–24)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 79:1
items.html: It is revealed at the end of correction, in the secret of the verse, “The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.” (618, Item 24)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 80:1
items.html: Because there was a nullification in their Achoraim at the time of the shattering of the vessels, for they fell from the aspect of Rosh to Guf, they therefore require the correction and sweetening of the new Mah. (Inner Light, p. 619, entry "From AVI")

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 81:1
items.html: For after the residues of smallness included in the screen were corrected, the residues of greatness included there could not receive anything from this illumination. Therefore, they, too, were aroused and rose as MAN to the head of SAG. And then, in order to illuminate them with the illumination of Hochma, SAG turned its face to AB in a face-to-face coupling, and the illumination of the coupling from AB brought the lower Hei down from the forehead to the mouth. (Inner Light, page 609, Sub Header, “Multiplication”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 82:1
items.html: For the Mochin of Gadlut of Aba ve Ima also come from the second division of Nekudim, from the aspect of PBP, which were there completed entirely in each of their aspects of GAR, before they received the MAN of Vav and a dot from the Yesod of AK. And it is known that the breaking occurred only in the Mochin that come from the MAN of the Yesod of AK, and although the Mochin of the second division were also nullified, this was only because they became joined together with the Mochin of the third division that come from Vav and a dot. Hence, now that they have already been clarified and separated from the Mochin of the third division, there is no longer any flaw in them, and the Mochin remain fixed. Moreover, the whole matter of the lack of permanence in the Mochin is due to the flaw that the lower ones raise, and the deeds of the lower ones do not reach the aspect of the Mochin of Aba ve Ima that come from the second division, since the lower ones have no part in them, for they come from the Mochin of the third division. Hence they cannot, through their deeds, cause the departure of the Mochin except in ZON, whose Gadlut likewise comes from the third division. (Inner Light, page 620, Sub Header, “In AVI.” And page 658, Sub Header, “And With This You Will Understand”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 83:1
items.html: The Mochin fixed in Atik, Arich Anpin, and Aba and Ima of Atzilut were corrected from the second division of Nekudim, where the correction was only in the heads alone, which are regarded as the phase of the Ketarim; but the nine lower Sefirot of Nekudim, namely the bodies in them, came out only from the third division, as is known. Accordingly, it is found that all the Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama, Haya, Yechida of Atzilut are the Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama, Haya, Yechida of Keter alone, and they lack the nine lower Sefirot in comparison to Nekudim. (Inner Light, page 684, Sub Header, “And With This”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 84:1
items.html: All the Mochin that come out by the MAN of the third division of Nekudim, which are of the phase of the MAN of a Vav and a dot, are not fixed in Atzilut, but depend on the deeds of the lower ones. And this is because these Mochin do not come out except through their good deeds, and this is the reason that when the lower ones are not worthy, these Mochin return and depart, since these Mochin came out chiefly by their merit alone. (Inner Light, page 659, Sub Header, “However”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 85:1
items.html: See above, answer 84.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 86:1
items.html: The Mochin of ZON, since they come to them through good deeds and MAN that the lower ones raise, as said above in answer 84, therefore, when they are not worthy, they can flaw them, meaning that the Mochin depart. But above ZON, the Mochin in them were corrected from above downward, not through the deeds of the lower ones, namely from the MAN of the second division, in which the lower ones have no part at all. (Inner Light, page 633, Sub Header, “And This”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 87:1
items.html: The first division is the smallness (Katnut) of the Nekudim, which came from the sockets of the eyes, which is the state of back to back (AB“A) of Aba ve Ima. The second division is from the new light that broke through the Parsa and descended and shone through the navel of Adam Kadmon, bringing the letter Hey down to its place, to the mouth of the Nekudim; and Aba ve Ima returned to the aspect of Rosh and attained their GAR, which is the state of face to back (PB“A) of Aba ve Ima, for Ima still does not turn her face to Aba, because it is a desire of grace. And the third division is the aspect of the Mayin Nukvin of Vav and a dot, which Aba ve Ima received from the Yesod of Adam Kadmon, which returned Aba ve Ima to the state of face to face, and they bore the Mochin of the seven lower (ZAT) of the Nekudim, all of them. (Inner Light, Item 624, Sub Header, “And in This You Will Understand That There Is”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 88:1
items.html: The Mochin that were corrected by the first two divisions remain permanently corrected and never depart again, and the actions of the lower ones do not reach them. However, the Mochin that come from the MAN of the third division, since they come from below upward — meaning that the lower ones must raise this MAN — are therefore also reached by a flaw from the lower ones, and these Mochin are not permanent, but rise and fall according to the actions of the lower ones. (page 625, Sub Header, “The Choicest”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 89:1
items.html: The couplings of the Partzufim, in regard to the fixed Mochin in Atzilut, are considered a coupling that is not entirely complete, and this is for two reasons: First, in relation to their former state that they had in Nekudim, they lack the nine lower Sefirot, as said above in answer 83. Second, that they cannot bestow upon ZON the Mochin of the birth of souls, but only the Mochin of AHBA alone. (Inner Light, page 661, Sub Header, “Now”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 90:1
items.html: The couplings of the Partzufim from the aspect of the Mochin of greatness, which come by means of the Mayin Nukvin that the lower ones raise up to Zeir Anpin and Nukva — whereby the Partzufim each rise above their degree — are called ‘a complete coupling, but not entirely.’ For on one hand it is called a complete coupling, since these couplings bestow the Mochin for the birth of souls, and from this side they are deemed complete. However, in relation to the state they had at the time of the Nekudim, these Mochin are not complete, since their whole correction comes through the ascents of the Partzufim, and they are found in Beriah-Yetzira-Assiya (BYA), not corrected in their actual place, the way they shone at the time of the Kings, when they were in the aspect of true Atzilut. And from this side, they are still considered incomplete. (ibid., Sub Header, “Division 2”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 91:1
items.html: At the end of the correction (Gmar Tikkun), when the Mochin of Yechida remain permanently and BYA are corrected in their place to the aspect of Atzilut, which is the secret of the feet reaching the feet [Matei Raglin beRaglin], as above in Answer 33 — then it is considered a completely perfect coupling. (ibid., s.v. "third division")

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 92:1
items.html: There is no difference — either all are complete, or all are not complete, even Atik and Arich Anpin. (ibid., Sub Header, “And you”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 93:1
items.html: Bina is the Jerusalem above, and Malchut is called the Jerusalem below. (ibid., Sub Header, “Now”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 94:1
items.html: The oath concerns a fully complete coupling, meaning of the aspect of feet touching feet, as it was in the time of the Kings, and as it shall be at the end of correction, for only this is called a fully complete coupling. And God swore that He would not enter into a fully complete coupling in the Jerusalem above, until He enters into a fully complete coupling in the Jerusalem below. (Ibid., Sub Header, “Now.”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 95:1
items.html: There are four aspects in Abba and Ima, and the fourth aspect of Abba and Ima becomes Mochin for ZON. (Inner Light, page 632, Sub Header, “And behold”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 96:1
items.html: Since Zeir Anpin is VAK of MA, and the Nukva is VAK of BON, and within the NHY of Aba that are clothed in Zeir Anpin as Mochin there is both MA and BON, and likewise within the NHY of Ima that are clothed in the Nukva there is also both MA and BON — how then can the MA of Ima be clothed in the Nukva, who is entirely BON, and how can the BON of Aba be clothed in Zeir Anpin, who is entirely MA? Therefore, the Mochin of Aba ve Ima exchange places when they clothe in Zeir Anpin and Nukva: the MA that is in the NHY of Ima comes into the NHY of Aba, and the BON that is in the NHY of Aba comes into the NHY of Ima. Then the NHY of Aba has his own MA and the MA of Ima, so that it is found to be entirely MA, and therefore it clothes in Zeir Anpin, who is likewise entirely MA. And likewise, the NHY of Ima, which now has her own BON and the BON of Aba, clothes in the Nukva, who is entirely BON. (Inner Light, Item 668, Sub Header, “It Is Found”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 97:1
items.html: At the time when AVI are face-to-back, the ZON of Ima are included in the GAR of Ima and have no revelation, because the very essence of ZON is the illumination of Chochma that they receive from Ima, and Ima cannot draw the illumination of Chochma before she turns face-to-face with Abba. But when she receives MAN and turns her face to Abba, she then begets the Mochin for ZON, and then the ZAT are revealed in Ima herself as well, and she now has ten complete Sefirot. These ZAT that are now revealed are called the Mocha DeDaat. (Inner Light, page 645, Sub Header, “And In This”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 98:1
items.html: The essence of the Mocha DeDaat is only the five Chassadim and five Gevurot, since they are only the aspects of ZON of the Rosh that are revealed through the raising of MAN, as above in the preceding Answer 97. It is known that the essence of ZON is only Chesed and Gevura, whose GAR are called HGT, and whose ZAT are called Netzach and Hod, as is known, and hence the HGT NH of ZA are called the five Chassadim, and the HGT NH of the Nukva are the five Gevurot. But through the illumination of Chochma that they attain from Ima, HGT return to the aspect of HBD, and NHY to HGT, and they acquire new NHY. (Ibid., Sub Header, “Although”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 99:1
items.html: For Daat contains only five Chassadim and five Gevurot, as above in Answer 98, since HGT became HBD. Thus HB are found in Chesed and Gevura, and Daat in Tiferet. You already know that above the Chazeh of Tiferet, the Chassadim are covered, and the illumination of Chochma is revealed only from the Chazeh downward, and hence the light of Daat clothed in Tiferet is divided, even now, into two aspects: above the Chazeh, Daat is covered, and is called “the concealed Daat,” and from the Chazeh downward, where the Chassadim are revealed, it is called “the extended Daat.” (Ibid., page 646, Sub Header, “Also”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 100:1
items.html: For the male, who is MA, has a root also from BON that belongs to the female, since he bestows the BON upon the female, hence the root necessarily remains in him, as is known. But the female has only BON, which is her own part, while from MA she has only an illumination alone, and therefore her Daat is light, for she has only the five Gevurot from BON, and lacks the five Hassadim that are from MA. (Inner Light, page 620, Sub Header, “Her Daat”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 101:1
items.html: The root of the emergence of Bina from the Rosh of AA is likewise rooted in the ten Sefirot of direct light, for Bina of direct light, being desirous of Hesed, turns her back to Hochma and her face to Keter — meaning she does not wish to receive the light of Hochma, but rather nurses the light of Hassadim from Keter of direct light, as was explained in Part One. Hence now in Atzilut, where Keter itself divided and became two Partzufim, Atik and AA — Atik being the root for the imparting of Hassadim, and AA being the root for the imparting of Hochma — since it is not the nature of Bina to receive Hochma but rather Hassadim, she came out from this Rosh, that of AA, which is the root for Hochma, and she receives the light of Hassadim from Atik, who is the root for Hassadim, as stated. And for this reason Bina does not come out from the Rosh of Atik, even though it is higher than AA, because there is all her nursing and her desire, but she has no nursing from AA, since he is the root that imparts Hochma, as explained. And likewise, for the same reason, Bina did not come out from the Rosh of Aba ve Ima, since the level of Aba ve Ima of Atzilut is the level of Bina, which is also the light of Hassadim; hence she also has a place there in the Rosh, as stated (in Inner Observation, item 10, Sub Header, “And You Shall Understand”). And there are yet other reasons for the matter of Bina's emergence from the Rosh of AA, as stated (in Inner Light, page 634, Sub Header, “And the Partzuf, at the Outset”).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 102:1
items.html: When the lower one rises as MAN to the upper one and returns Aba ve Ima of the upper one face to face, then the bottom Hey descends, and afterward the AHP are returned to the Partzuf, and the level of Gadlut comes out there for the sake of the lower one. Now, these AHP that returned to the Rosh due to the descent of the bottom Hey do not belong to the upper one at all; rather, they are the portion of the lower one who rose there as MAN. For example, if the lower one is AA, then the AHP that were returned by the illumination of the coupling through Aba ve Ima of Atik do not belong to Atik at all, since a complete NHY of Atik is already there, which it attained during its inclusion in the Rosh of SAG of AK. Moreover, the AHP that belong to Atik are of phase four and the level of Keter, whereas these AHP that came out through the power of the inclusion of the coupling of AA are only of phase three and the level of Hochma. Hence, although they came out in the Rosh of Atik, they nevertheless belong to AA. And so, when AA comes out from the Rosh of Atik and comes to its place, it takes with it the AHP that came out for its own MAN while it was in the Rosh of Atik. Now, on the one hand, one might consider them a part of Atik, since indeed they came out there in the Rosh of Atik; however, since they do not belong to the aspect of Atik, they must be considered the aspect of AA, and hence they descend as garments of Mochin and clothe the Rosh of AA. And so it is with all the Partzufim: those AHP that came out on account of their own MAN, in their inclusion in the upper one, are drawn with them when they go out from there to their own place, and are considered garments of Mochin for them, for the reason explained. And you already know that AHP are always considered the aspect of NHY. Hence we call these AHP by the name NHY. (Inner Light, page 637, Sub Header, “Now”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 103:1
items.html: For the NHY of the upper one that are clothed as the garments of Mochin in the lower one are, in truth, only the portion of the lower one, since they came out there in the upper one because of his MAN, as said above (previous item). However, these NHY of the upper one that are clothed in the lower one are not at all the phase of a head, but the phase of a body, and they are the very self of the upper one; only that the lower one fills them with his illuminations, in the way that every lower one fills the body of the upper one. (Inner Light, page 636, Sub Header, “GAR”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 104:1
items.html: There are three phases of NHY of the Rosh: first, the NHY of the Rosh of the Partzuf itself; second, the NHY of the Rosh that are revealed in it through the raising of MAN by the one below it; third, the NHY of the Rosh that are revealed in it through the raising of MAN by the son of the one below it. (ibid., s.v. "and you shall know")

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 105:1
items.html: Netzach and Hod are considered the aspect of GAR, and Yesod is ZAT. And they divide in this manner: Netzach divides into three thirds along the right line, namely Hochma, Hesed, and Netzach. Hod divides into three thirds along the left line, namely Bina, Gevura, and Hod. And Yesod divides into three thirds, namely Daat, Tifferet, and Yesod, along the middle line. And you should understand that the two lines, right and left, have the standing of GAR, and the middle line has the standing of ZAT, for Hochma and Bina are GAR, and Daat is their ZAT. Likewise, Hesed and Gevura are the aspect of GAR, and Tifferet is the aspect of their ZAT; and likewise, Netzach and Hod are the aspect of GAR, and Yesod is the aspect of their ZAT. (Inner Light, Item 644, Sub Header, “Also”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 106:1
items.html: The Rosh of Atik clothes from the navel of AK downward to the mouth of Nekudim, meaning throughout the entire place of the three first Sefirot of Nekudim. And the seven lower Sefirot of Atik clothe in the place of the seven lower Sefirot of Nekudim. (Inner Light, p. 611, entry "Indeed")

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 107:1
items.html: The Rosh of AA clothes from the Peh of Atik downward to the Chazeh. The reason for this is that the screen of Behina Gimel has its source in the aspect of the screen of the Guf of Behina Dalet, as it was in AK, and as it was in the Partzufim of Nekudim, from where all the screens of Atzilut came. Hence, after AA was included in the inclusion of the coupling of the head of Atik, the coarseness of the Guf that was in the screen was discerned, and so it returned to its place, the place of the Chazeh of the Guf of Atik. From the Chazeh upward to the Peh it elicited the ten Sefirot of the Rosh, and from the Chazeh downward to the end of Atzilut it elicited the ten Sefirot of the Guf. (Inner Light, page 626, Sub Header, “And Arich”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 108:1
items.html: The Rosh of Aba ve Ima clothes AA from the Peh downward, down to the chest of AA. For the screen of phase two, over which the level of MA of Aba ve Ima came out, is the aspect of the screen of the Guf of phase three, which is the level of AA — just as in the cascading of the Partzufim of AK and Nekudim. Hence, after the inclusion of the coupling of Aba ve Ima in the Rosh of AA was completed, they went out and descended to their place, and came to the place of the chest of AA, and the ten Sefirot of the Rosh came out from the chest upward to the Peh of AA, and the ten Sefirot of the Guf, from the chest downward to the Tabur of AA. And the reason Aba ve Ima were not drawn down to the end of the legs of AA, but were cut off at the Tabur of AA, stems from the power of the correction of the Parsa within the innards of AK, which separates between AB and SAG of AK, considered Akudim, and ZON of AK, considered Nekudim. And so it is also in Atzilut, where the Parsa was corrected within the innards of AA, separating between Aba ve Ima, which are the aspect of Yod-Hey of Atzilut, and ZON, which are the aspect of Vav-Hey of Atzilut. And the difference between them is similar to the difference of the Parsa in AK, for Aba ve Ima, who are above the Parsa, resemble Akudim of AK, meaning that from their root in AK they are clean of the bottom Hey. And ZON, who are below the Parsa of AA, have within them the joining of the bottom Hey with the first Hey even from their root in AK. This will be explained at length in the coming parts.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 109:1
items.html: The Rosh of ZON clothes from the Tabur of AA downward, to the end of the Tiferet of AA, which includes also the upper joints of the Netzach-Hod that are connected to the Tiferet. The Guf of ZON clothes the remaining lower Ben Shesh that are in the Netzach-Hod-Yesod of AA, to the end of Atzilut, as explained well in its place. However, the ends of Netzach-Hod-Yesod of AVI also extend into ZON, and so ZON are found clothing AVI, too, from the Tabur downward, just as they clothe AA. This is only in the Katnut of ZON, but in the Gadlut of ZON, they clothe AVI from the Chazeh downward, as will be explained at length in its place.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 110:1
items.html: For the Rosh of AA clothes the HGT of Atik, as above in Answer 107, and NHY remained for the Guf of AA, which is its own HGT NHY. And behold, the NHY of Atik divide into thirds: Rosh, Toch, Sof. Where the three upper thirds are considered HBD, the three middle thirds HGT, and the three lower thirds NHYM — this when they are all full of their lights. However, here in Atik, the lower thirds went out beyond Atzilut into BYA, as is known. It follows that the lower thirds are lacking the light of Atzilut, since the light of Atzilut does not go out below the Parsa of Atzilut. And it is known that there is an inverse relation between the lights and the vessels, for when the NHY of the vessels are lacking, the HBD of the lights are found lacking. It follows that there are here only the lights of HGT in the vessels of HBD, which are the upper thirds of the NHY of Atik, and the lights of NHY in the vessels of HGT, meaning in the middle thirds of Atik. Hence the upper thirds, which now have only lights of HGT, clothe the HGT of AA, and the middle thirds, which now have only lights of NHY, clothe the NHY of AA. (Inner Light, page 642, Sub Header, “And Behold”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 111:1
items.html: The Malchut of Atik that clothes in Arich Anpin is only the illumination of his Malchut, for the Malchut of Atik in its essence is hidden in Radla, as in the words of the Rav, p. 618, Item 23. (Inner Light, p. 632, entry "And behold")

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 112:1
items.html: The male of Atik is the level of Keter that came out in Atzilut on the screen of phase four, and the female of Atik is made of four aspects. The first is half of the Keter of Nekudim, which is the aspect of Katnut that came out in the Keter of Nekudim, considered only the aspect of the Guf and Etzem of Keter, since the lower vessels of Keter, which are AHP, came out only during Gadlut, and they are considered the lower half of Keter, which AA took. But Atik took only the upper half, which are the Guf and Etzem alone. The second is the GAR of Hochma, which is the aspect of Aba of Nekudim that came out during Katnut, likewise only of the aspect of the Guf and Etzem alone, since the ZAT of Hochma, which are the aspects of its AHP, were taken by Aba of Atzilut. The third is the GAR of Bina, meaning the aspect of the Guf and Etzem of Bina of Nekudim that came out during Katnut. However, this Guf and Etzem that came out during Katnut in the GAR of Nekudim in truth also includes Bina from the aspect of her own GAR, for although we say that AHP go outward, that does not mean the whole ten Sefirot of the ear, since the matter of going outward does not apply to the GAR of the ear, they being the light of Hassadim; rather, only the ZAT of the ear, which are already in an illumination of Hochma, went outward. Hence the Guf and Etzem that remained in Katnut also include the GAR of the ear. So the Guf and Etzem are considered the three Sefirot KHB. And all three aspects that the Nukva of Atik took from the GAR of Nekudim are the three aspects of GAR, namely GAR of Keter of Nekudim, GAR of Hochma of Nekudim, and GAR of Bina of Nekudim. However, Bina also took Hesed, and this is because as long as the ZAT of Bina had not yet expanded, Hesed was found included in Bina; hence it is considered that the Nukva of Atik took the four first ones of Bina, which are Galgalta, Einayim, GAR of the ear, and Hesed. The fourth is the Ketarim of ZAT of Nekudim, meaning from the aspect of what the Keter of Katnut illuminated to the ZAT of Nekudim, which the Nukva of Atik took as her own aspects of ZAT. And the reason the Nukva of Atik chose for herself all four of the aforesaid aspects is that she took all the lights that the breaking did not strike, and which are found in the place of her clothing, since the Rosh of Atik clothes the whole place where the GAR of Nekudim stood, as above in Answer 106. It follows on its own that she took all the lights that remained standing there. (Inner Light, page 625, Sub Header, “Atik”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 113:1
items.html: The male of Arich Anpin is the level of Hochma that came out in Atzilut, upon a screen of phase three, in the inclusion of the coupling in the Rosh of Atik. And the Nukva of Arich Anpin is the phase of the lower half of the Keter of Nekudim, which is the phase of AHP of Keter that came out at the time of the Gadlut of Nekudim, by a new light that broke through the Parsa and illuminated the Keter of Nekudim through the Tabur of AK. And it is called the BON of Arich Anpin. (Inner Light, page 626, Sub Header, “And Arich”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 114:1
items.html: The male of the first pair is the two Sefirot Keter and Hochma of the stature of Bina of MA, which came out on the screen of phase two, within the inclusion of the coupling in the Rosh of Arich Anpin. And the Nukva of the first pair is Zeir Anpin of Hochma of BON, namely half of the Hochma of the Nekudim that remained from the Nekudim after the Nukva of Atik took the GAR within them, which is the aspects of ZON of the ear, and the nose and mouth, that came out in Aba of the Nekudim at the time of greatness, when he received the illumination of the new light from the navel of Adam Kadmon through the Keter. However, the Nukva of the first pair took only the aspect of Zeir Anpin of Hochma of the Nekudim, namely the Zeir Anpin of the ear and the general Zeir Anpin; but the aspect of the Malchut of this Hochma she did not take, for it belongs to the Nukva of the third pair, as we shall write further on. (Inner Light, Item 654, Sub Header, “And It Is Necessary”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 115:1
items.html: The male of the second pair is the Bina of the stature of Bina, as above in Answer 114, for the second pair is considered, as a whole, to be of the aspect of a Nukva to the first pair. Hence the male of the first pair took the Hochma of MA, who is a true male; and even the Nukva of the first pair is likewise male, for she is the Zeir Anpin of Hochma, who is male, except that, being BON, needing correction from MA, she is therefore termed female. But in the second pair, even the male among them is found to be female, for it is the Bina of the stature of Bina, which is female, except that it is called male because it is from the name MA, which bestows and corrects the BON, and is therefore called by the name male. And the Nukva of the second pair is the lower half of the Bina of the Nekudim that remained after the first four of it were taken by Atik, as above in Answer 106, apart from the Malchut within it, which was taken by the Nukva of the fourth pair, as we shall write below. (Inner Light, Item 626, Sub Header, “And It Is Long”, and Item 654, Sub Header, “And It Is Necessary”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 116:1
items.html: The male of the third pair is the ZA of the level of Bina mentioned above in Answer 114. The Nukva of the third pair is the Malchut of the Chochma of BON, which is the Malchut of the Gadlut of Abba of Nekudim, which remained from the Nukva of the first pair, as above in Answer 114. Observe that the male and female of the first pair together with the male and female of the third pair — all four of them together — are, at the time of Gadlut, only a single Partzuf, called the Abba of Atzilut, whose MA side is Keter-Chochma-ZA of the level of Bina of MA, and whose BON side is the ZA and Malchut of the Chochma of BON. (Ibid. and Ibid.)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 117:1
items.html: The male of the fourth pair is the Malchut that remains from the stature of Bina of MA, after the males of the three preceding pairs took the first nine Sefirot of this stature. And the Nukva of the fourth pair is the Malchut of Bina of BON, from which the Nukva of the second pair took the Gevura, Tifferet, and NHY of it, as above in Answer 115. And know that the second pair and the fourth pair, all four of them together, become at the time of greatness one Partzuf, called Ima of Atzilut, whose MA side is the Bina and Malchut of the stature of Bina of MA, and whose BON side is the six Sefirot of Bina of BON. Also know that the two upper pairs, the first and second pairs, are called together Aba ve Ima Ilain, who clothe the HGT of Arich Anpin down to the chest; and the two lower pairs, the third and fourth pairs, are called together Aba ve Ima Tatain, or Yisrael Saba veTevuna, who clothe from the chest of Arich Anpin downward. (Inner Light, Item 654, Sub Header, “And It Is Necessary”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 118:1
items.html: The male of the great ZON is the HGT NHY of the level of MA, which is the level of Nefesh Ruach that came out in Atzilut for the sake of ZA, and the male of the great ZON took all the VAK of this level, and its Malchut was taken by the male of the small ZON, as will be explained below. The Nukva of the great ZON took the VAK of BON, meaning the aspect of the ZAT of Nekudim, aside from the Malchut of Nekudim, which was taken by the Nukva of the small ZON. (Inner Light, page 664, Sub Header, “The ZA”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 119:1
items.html: The male of the small ZON took the Malchut of MA that remained after the VAK of MA, which the male of the great ZON took, as above. And the female of the small ZON took the Malchut of BON, meaning the Malchut of Nekudim that remained after the VAK of Nekudim, which the female of the great ZON took. (Ibid.)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 120:1
items.html: At the time of greatness, the male of the greater ZON, together with the male of the lesser ZON, become one Partzuf called Zeir Anpin of Atzilut, and then the male is found entirely as MA, namely the ZAT of MA. And the two females of the greater ZON and the lesser ZON likewise become one Partzuf, and then the female is entirely BON, namely the ZAT of the Nekudim. And sometimes they divide into two Partzufim in this manner: the greater ZON, both together, are considered the male, called Zeir Anpin of Atzilut, and it is found to have a side of MA, which is VAK of MA, and a side of BON, which is VAK of BON. And likewise the male and female of the lesser ZON, both together, are considered one Partzuf called the Nukva of Zeir Anpin, and the Nukva, too, is found to have a side of MA and a side of BON, which are the Malchut of MA and the Malchut of BON. (ibid.)
